description: A point-in-time OPINION-FREE ref pre-selection a doper assembles per (owner, step); open on an existing pair RESETS to building and truncates the ref children. Refs are typed child rows (dope children carry ghost-legal dot-path CODES; kbite/file-change children carry uuid FKs). Staleness = server-stamped scope revision, compared live at read (warn, never block). BOUNDARY: a briefing answers 'what refs did this agent get'; agent_registration answers 'who is agent X'.
